definition: Total value of all invoiced sales before returns, discounts and VAT.
Gross revenue minus returns, discounts and VAT. This is the revenue figure used in management reporting.
(Net revenue - cost of goods sold) / net revenue, shown as a percentage. Measures how much of each euro of revenue is left after direct costs.
Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortisation. Used as a proxy for operating cash profitability.
Average number of days it takes to collect payment after an invoice is issued. Calculated as accounts receivable / net revenue x days in period.
A customer with at least one paid order in the last 90 days.
Net revenue divided by the number of paid orders in the same period.
A previously active customer with no paid order for more than 180 days.
Total marketing and sales spend in a period divided by the number of new customers acquired in that period.
Share of website sessions that end in a paid order, shown as a percentage.
Time since the last successful pipeline run. Dashboards show a "stale" warning if it exceeds 24 hours.
